_doc: v0.2.100 review W2R-04: the `compose config` render shapes vco_lib.data_identity.render_mount must read,
PROVENANCE: these renders are RECONSTRUCTED from each engine's documented `config` output shape for VCO's own
infrastructure/docker-compose.yml stanzas (`${VCT_<SVC>_DATA_SOURCE:-<key>}:<dest>` + a top-level volumes map
whose `name:` is `${VCT_<SVC>_VOLUME_NAME:-vco_<svc>_...}`): docker compose v2 normalises every entry to the long
syntax (type/source/target + bind:/volume: sub-keys) and prints every volume's resolved `name:`; podman-compose
prints the merged file as written (short strings, a volumes map that may lack `name:` or be null). They were NOT
captured from a live engine by the lane that wrote them (no container command may run there) — the v0.2.100
dogfood step 3 captures real renders on BOTH providers and any divergence is added here as a new case.
Fields: render (YAML text of the `config` stdout), service, project (the -p value; null = unknown), live (one
`inspect .Mounts` entry of the running container, or null), expect_mount (the parsed mount; `{infra}` = the
compose dir), expect_verdict (recreate_preserves_data against `live`), expect_error (substrings of the precise
fail-closed reason: which field, which service).

cases.name: docker compose v2, Linux, the owner's bind (long syntax, create_host_path, selinux)
cases.render:
name: infrastructure
services:
  ollama:
    container_name: vco_ollama
    image: docker.io/ollama/ollama:latest
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 11434
        published: "11435"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /home/user/podman_volumes/ollama/models
        target: /root/.ollama
        bind:
          selinux: Z
          create_host_path: true
networks:
  default:
    name: infrastructure_default
volumes:
  ollama_data:
    name: vco_ollama_data

cases.name: docker compose v2, Linux, the default named volume (long syntax, volume: {})
cases.render:
name: infrastructure
services:
  weaviate:
    container_name: vco_weaviate
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: weaviate_data
        target: /var/lib/weaviate
        volume: {}
volumes:
  weaviate_data:
    name: vco_weaviate_data

cases.name: docker compose v2, a VCT_<SVC>_VOLUME_NAME knob (volume: {nocopy: true})
cases.render:
services:
  code_embed:
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: code_embed_cache
        target: /cache
        volume:
          nocopy: true
volumes:
  code_embed_cache:
    name: legacy_embed_cache

cases.name: docker compose v2, the render names the default volume while the data is on a bind
cases.render:
services:
  ollama:
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: ollama_data
        target: /root/.ollama
        volume: {}
volumes:
  ollama_data:
    name: vco_ollama_data
